Great food and service for those wanting Western foods.
Apr 2023 • Friends
Having been to this restaurant on 2 previous visits to Nha Trang I ventured here again at a new venue. Once again I found a very warm welcome, and excellent food. 
Maybe the place was a little harder to find, but certainly worth taking the extra to get there. A little hidden from passing traffic, I found the menu excellent, quality of food and service top standard.
I would recommend Swiss House to anybody looking for a change from Vietnamese food, and the welcome from Hugo and Thao made me feel at home.
